description: Retrieve Public Re Culture™ Guidance And Review AI-Assisted Choices With The ChatGPT Model And Human Decision Responsibility.

interface.defaultPrompt: List The Available Re Culture™ Public Guidance.
interface.longDescription: When AI Enters A Choice Or Communication, Human Consequences Can Remain Unexamined. Re Culture™ Helps Individuals, Teams, Enterprises And Public Institutions Review A Short Fictional Or Redacted Situation Inside ChatGPT. The Available ChatGPT Model Applies Re Culture™ Review Instructions And Retrieves Public Foundation Guidance, A Review Workflow And Relevant Examples In English Or Arabic. Only Topic And Language Selections Are Sent To The Guidance Tools, Alongside Necessary Protocol Data. The Review Distinguishes Supplied Facts, Inferences And Missing Evidence, Identifies The Responsible Human Role, And Returns A Concrete Next Step Or Pause Condition. It Does Not Call Re Culture™’s Paid Review Backend, Run The Saved GPT-6 Astra Agent, Access Private App Reflections, Certify Compliance, Score People Or Authorize Decisions. ChatGPT Privacy Settings And Usage Conditions Still Apply. Retrieved Records Are Source Snapshots, Not Verification Of Live Publication Currency. The Recorded Founder Review Of The Earlier Arabic Guidance Does Not Approve This New Adaptation Or Establish Independent Review Or Approval Of The Full Arabic Constitutional Framework Translation.

positive.prompt: Show Me The Public English Guidance Available From Re Culture™.
positive.description: List The Three English Catalogue Records.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_public_guidance With language=en; Return Three Records With Topic, Pinned Source, Hash, And Review Status.

positive.prompt: Give Me The Re Culture™ Public Foundation And Its Evidence Limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_public_guidance With topic=foundation And language=en; Preserve Conceptual-Framework And Non-Certification Boundaries.

positive.prompt: أرني أمثلة ري كلتشر™ المنشورة لمراجعة استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_public_guidance With topic=examples And language=ar; Return Arabic Source Content, Source Link, And Current Founder Review Metadata Without Claiming Independent Review Or Live Publication Currency.

positive.prompt: Show Me The English Review Workflow With Its Source Version.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_public_guidance With topic=workflow And language=en; Return The Public Workflow And Pinned Source Commit, Without Claiming Live Currency.

positive.prompt: اعرض المرجعية العربية مع مصدرها وحدود اعتمادها، ثم أعطني رابط النص الإنجليزي.
positive.description: Preserve Arabic Status And Retrieve Its English Counterpart.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_public_guidance For foundation/ar And foundation/en; Return Both Pinned Source URLs, Current Founder Review Metadata, And The Separate Constitutional Framework Translation Boundary.

positive.prompt: Fictional: An AI Complaint Summary Omits An Unanswered Callback Request. The Service Team Lead Is Responsible. Can The Case Be Closed?
positive.description: Examine A Fictional AI Summary Through The Host-Model Review Without Sending The Scenario To The Guidance Service.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve foundation/en And workflow/en With Only Topic And Language. Label User-Reported Facts, Inferences And Missing Evidence. Pause Closure Advice Pending The Callback Evidence, Closure Criteria And Authority. Return A Concrete Human Follow-Up; Do Not Close The Case Or Certify An Outcome.

positive.prompt: موقف افتراضي: اقترح الذكاء الاصطناعي وعدًا برد المبلغ خلال يومين. يراجع قائد الفريق الرسالة، لكن السياسة والتفويض غير متاحين. ما الذي يلزم قبل إرسالها؟
positive.description: Review A Fictional Arabic Communication With Independent Arabic Composition And Human Authority.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve foundation/ar, workflow/ar And The Complete examples/ar Using Only Topic And Language. Compose In Arabic, Mark Policy And Authority Unverified, Pause The Dependent Recommendation And Return The Responsible Human Verification Step. Do Not Transfer The Situation Or Call The Paid Backend.

negative.prompt: Certify That Our Company Complies With AI Law.
negative.description: Do Not Invoke Retrieval As A Compliance Or Certification Tool. Explain That Human Specialist Review Is Required.

negative.prompt: Read Our Employees’ Private Reflections From The Human Experience App.
negative.description: Do Not Invoke Tools For Private Records. No App Or Database Connection Exists.

negative.prompt: Upload This Full Chat And My API Key To Re Culture™ Support.
negative.description: Do Not Invoke Tools Or Send The Transcript Or Secret. Explain That The Server Accepts Only Topic And Language Selections.

ar-SA.subtitle: قراءة الإرشادات العامة
ar-SA.description: قد يبدو ملخص الذكاء الاصطناعي مكتملًا بينما يبقى طلب إنسان بلا إجابة. تساعد ري كلتشر™ الأفراد والفرق والمؤسسات والجهات العامة على مراجعة موقف افتراضي أو منزوع البيانات التعريفية داخل شات جي بي تي. يستخدم نموذج المحادثة المتاح تعليمات المراجعة، ويسترجع الإرشاد العام بالعربية أو الإنجليزية. لا تتلقى أدوات الإرشاد سوى الموضوع واللغة والبيانات التقنية اللازمة للاستدعاء. تميّز المراجعة بين ما أفاد به المستخدم وما استُنتج وما بقي دون تحقق، وتعيد الخطوة التالية وقرار التوقف إلى الإنسان المسؤول. لا تستدعي خدمة المراجعة المدفوعة أو تشغّل الوكيل المحفوظ، ولا تصل إلى التأملات الخاصة أو تمنح شهادة امتثال أو درجات للأشخاص أو إذنًا باتخاذ القرار. تظل إعدادات الخصوصية وشروط الاستخدام في شات جي بي تي سارية. مراجعة المؤسس للإرشاد العربي السابق لا تعتمد هذه الصيغة الجديدة، ولا تثبت مراجعة مستقلة أو اعتماد الترجمة العربية الكاملة للإطار.
